explanation: Verified: -1 then 111. The first answer is *unknown*, not *never* — the program was still running. Simulation can confirm halting and can never confirm non-halting, because at any moment the possibilities are "it will stop later" and "it never will", and no finite observation separates them. A decision procedure would have to reason about the program rather than watch it.
